races.name: Dundalk Stadium Group Deals Available Apprentice Optional Claiming Race

runners_data.name: The Liffey
runners_data.note: Highest rated runner who should control the tempo from his prominent position and has strong recent form.

runners_data.name: Dontspoilasale
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with solid placed record on this going who will track the pace.

runners_data.name: Benavente
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent recent form including a 7f win last time out on identical conditions.

runners_data.name: Una Matata
runners_data.note: Another closer with a 7f win two runs back and strong record on good ground from 15 starts.

runners_data.name: Ruff Justice
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with moderate recent form but proven on this surface and distance combination.

runners_data.name: Thaloria
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off a good second last time who has won once from six starts on this going.

runners_data.name: Suerte
runners_data.note: Pace angle runner but winless in eight attempts on similar going with limited placed form.

runners_data.name: Crest Of Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent heavy ground effort can be forgiven and has won twice on good ground previously.

races.paceDynamic: The Liffey, Dontspoilasale, Thaloria, and Suerte will all contest the early pace from the gates, creating a competitive gallop over 7f. This strong pace should set up perfectly for the hold-up horses Benavente, Una Matata, Ruff Justice, and Crest Of Light to mount late challenges. The sustained tempo will likely see the early leaders come under pressure in the final 2f, opening the door for closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners (The Liffey, Dontspoilasale, Thaloria, Suerte) go too fast early.
scenarios.body: The leaders tie up badly in the final furlong as the pace takes its toll. Benavente and Una Matata sweep past with their superior closing kicks to dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If The Liffey controls the tempo and kicks clear when the pace lifts.
scenarios.body: The class horse uses his OR86 rating to dictate terms and finds enough at the finish. Dontspoilasale stays on strongly for second having tracked the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Perfect Pace Compromise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but sustainable, setting up a fair test.
scenarios.body: The race develops into a genuine staying test where both pace and closing styles get their chance. Una Matata and Thaloria emerge as the primary protagonists in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from Behind
scenarios.trigger: If Crest Of Light overcomes his poor recent heavy ground run and returns to best form.
scenarios.body: The outsider produces a career-best effort from his hold-up style to shock the field. Ruff Justice also benefits from the strong pace to grab a place.

watchPoints.text: The Liffey must be watched for how easily he travels in the early stages given his class advantage.
Benavente needs a strong pace to set up his finishing kick so monitor the early fractions carefully.
Una Matata has been hitting the frame regularly and represents the main hold-up threat if pace develops.
Dontspoilasale's consistency on this going makes him a reliable pace tracker to follow throughout.
Crest Of Light is worth monitoring for market support given his poor recent heavy ground effort may be misleading.

runners_data.name: Bishopton

runners_data.name: Musical Act
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who can press the pace but may lack finishing kick against this field

runners_data.name: Spinning Around
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner with recent 7f win, handles good ground well

runners_data.name: Venetian
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer with strong 15/15 good ground record and multiple places

runners_data.name: Blue Anthem
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to be effective, good recent third at this trip

runners_data.name: Um Wadi
runners_data.note: Needs to overcome poor strike-rate despite decent recent third, requires strong tempo

runners_data.name: Nikki Swango
runners_data.note: Strong 15/15 good ground record with four wins, proven 7f performer who can finish well

runners_data.name: Whistling Jamesie
runners_data.note: Recent 6f winner but concerning finishing record, fade tendency may resurface at 7f

races.paceDynamic: Bishopton appears the only natural leader with strong front-running credentials, while Musical Act, Spinning Around and Venetian will press close behind creating a moderate early gallop. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Blue Anthem, Um Wadi, Nikki Swango, Whistling Jamesie) suggests the pace will be sustainable through the middle stages before quickening late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bishopton controls uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Bishopton gets an uncontested lead with the prominent trio settling behind
scenarios.body: The leader maintains kick-back throughout while the hold-up brigade leaves their runs too late on the sustained pace. Bishopton's 14/15 similar going record and recent 7f wins make him perfectly suited.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent pace pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Musical Act, Spinning Around and Venetian all press Bishopton early creating stronger tempo
scenarios.body: The increased gallop sets up perfectly for the closers, with Nikki Swango's strong 7f record on good ground ideal. Um Wadi and Blue Anthem also benefit from the honest pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-race injection changes rhythm
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses kicks clear mid-race disrupting the steady tempo
scenarios.body: Spinning Around or Musical Act could exploit their versatile styles to change the race dynamic. The sudden injection catches some hold-up horses flat-footed while suiting those with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint finish scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout creating a bunched field turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test where Whistling Jamesie's finishing concerns become crucial. Venetian's consistent placings on similar going could prove decisive in a tight finish.

watchPoints.text: Whistling Jamesie's finishing stamina concerns could expose him badly if the pace quickens late at this longer trip
If Bishopton gets an easy early lead the hold-up horses may struggle to reel him in on this track
Musical Act and Spinning Around's early positioning will determine whether Bishopton faces genuine pace pressure
Um Wadi needs others to set strong tempo given poor recent strike-rate despite decent efforts
Venetian's consistent record suggests he'll be thereabouts but may lack killer blow to win

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Wind is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the tape, likely getting an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop. With most rivals preferring hold-up tactics (10 of 15), the pace will be moderate early before quickening significantly in the final 2f as the backmarkers launch their challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind gets easy fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up brigade leave too much to do. His superior tactical position proves decisive despite moderate ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swarm Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and multiple closers get clear runs
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up runners time their challenges perfectly in a bunched finish. Class tells as the better-rated closers prevail in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Press Forward
scenarios.trigger: If Comfort Line and Jazzy Dancer track Son Of Wind closely throughout
scenarios.body: The three early pace horses dominate from pillar to post, with the prominent runners having enough tactical speed to collar the leader. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind goes too slowly and gets swamped by superior ability late
scenarios.body: The tepid gallop becomes a sprint finish where pure class prevails over tactics. The highest-rated horses surge through despite poor positioning.

watchPoints.text: Son Of Wind getting soft fractions could prove decisive with so many hold-up horses behind him
Multiple hold-up horses including Jasmine Affanalis and Roman Harry needing clear runs in the straight
Vibrato, Qvee and Deep Vein all showing recent patterns of fading in the finish
Track Comfort Line and Jazzy Dancer early as the main threats to press the pace-setter
The large contingent of hold-up horses could create traffic problems turning for home

races.paceDynamic: Jazz Forever will set a steady pace from the front with minimal pressure, given the lack of other committed pace-setters in this field. The majority of runners prefer to sit back and come with late runs, creating a tactical affair where positioning in the straight becomes crucial. This setup favors horses that can quicken from prominent positions while potentially disadvantaging those needing a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Jazz Forever gets an easy lead and stays on
scenarios.body: Jazz Forever sets comfortable fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges in the final furlong. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the sustained pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and kick is required
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the best staying hold-up horses to wind up from the back and power through in the final two furlongs. Superior class tells when the race becomes a sprint.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Profits
scenarios.trigger: If Jazz Forever weakens and prominent horses pounce
scenarios.body: Jazz Forever's tendency to fade in the finish is exposed as Numidia and Hobart, tracking closer, have first run on the leader. The hold-up brigade gets caught flat-footed by the sudden injection of pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset from Improver
scenarios.trigger: If Desert Friend or Deluca Chop find extra gear
scenarios.body: Recent winner Desert Friend or consistent Deluca Chop produces career-best efforts to shock the higher-rated runners. Their positive momentum carries them past tiring favorites in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Jazz Forever's jumping and early positioning - if hesitant or headed early, pace could collapse completely
How quickly Mephisto and Disco Boy can get into contention - their class advantage needs time to tell
Whether Numidia can maintain prominent position without getting involved in a pace battle
Desert Friend's confidence levels after recent win - body language will indicate if more improvement likely
Track positioning of the main hold-up horses Slowdownbarney and Sarmiento Power in the back straight

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Maria Quiteria
runners_data.note: Won impressively on debut over this trip and distance, looks the form pick with proven prominent racing style.

runners_data.name: Arrowstock
runners_data.note: Lightly raced runner whose style and true ability remain question marks in a small field.

runners_data.name: Whammy
runners_data.note: Will control the pace from the front but finished fourth when last seen over this course and distance.

runners_data.name: Belle Island
runners_data.note: Showed promise when second on debut, should be competitive again from her tracking position.

runners_data.name: Brazilian Diva
runners_data.note: Hold up style suits if pace develops but sprint distance may not play to her closing strengths.

runners_data.name: Lamar River
runners_data.note: Significantly lower official rating suggests she faces a tough task against these rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Whammy as the sole confirmed front runner will dictate terms from the gate in this small field, likely setting an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop. With Maria Quiteria and Belle Island tracking prominently while Brazilian Diva and Lamar River sit deeper, the race sets up for either Whammy to control throughout or the prominent trackers to pounce if the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Whammy Wire to Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Whammy breaks cleanly and finds an easy rhythm on the front end
scenarios.body: The leader faces minimal early pressure and kicks clear in the final furlong as the closers struggle to make up ground over 5f. Maria Quiteria and Belle Island can never quite get on terms despite tracking in good positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Maria Quiteria or Belle Island can sit perfectly behind Whammy's pace
scenarios.body: The eventual winner stalks the leader before swooping past in the final 100 yards as Whammy's effort flattens. Brazilian Diva makes late ground but the sprint distance limits her closing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes stronger than expected with multiple horses pressing Whammy
scenarios.body: Brazilian Diva benefits from the increased tempo as the front runners tire, timing her run to perfection. The faster pace sets up ideally for her closing style while Whammy and the prominent runners pay for their earlier exertions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Arrowstock Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly raced Arrowstock shows significantly improved ability from an ideal position
scenarios.body: The newcomer produces a performance well above expectations to catch the favorites napping. Maria Quiteria and Belle Island finish best of the known quantities as form horses.

watchPoints.text: Whammy must break alertly to secure the early lead as any delay could see Maria Quiteria or Belle Island press forward.
Brazilian Diva needs the pace to develop strongly early to have any chance of getting into contention over this sharp 5f trip.
Arrowstock's market moves given her lightly raced profile and unknown style preferences in this small field.
Maria Quiteria's position early will be crucial as she needs to track Whammy without getting too keen or too far back.
The small field size means any horse that gets outpaced early will struggle to recover over the minimum distance.

races.paceDynamic: Wild Sapphire and potentially Nelliestar will set a measured pace from the front, with no genuine speed horses to pressure them early. The massive hold-up brigade of 10 runners will create a cavalry charge finish, but the sustainable pace means the leaders won't stop dramatically.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Sapphire maintains her recent prominent form and the pace stays honest
scenarios.body: The front two get first run while the pack is still organizing behind them. Wild Sapphire's consistent placings on good ground give her the edge over the hold-up army.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Rises Late
scenarios.trigger: If Poet's Willow overcomes her finishing concerns and gets the right split
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner times her challenge perfectly as lesser rivals hit the front too soon. Her OR-120 rating tells over this longer trip despite recent fading.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Form Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Gaiety Girl reproduces her recent winning form and gets clear running
scenarios.body: The only recent winner in the field capitalizes on her confidence and perfect going record. Her 4-from-4 record on similar going outweighs the rating disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Sapphire goes too fast early under pressure from Nelliestar
scenarios.body: Both leaders capitulate in the straight leaving the race to the best of the closers. Grecian Power's consistent hold-up style benefits most from the setup.

watchPoints.text: Poet's Willow's finishing kick may fail again given her recent fading pattern
Wild Sapphire must handle early pressure from Nelliestar without going too fast
Gaiety Girl needs clear passage in the straight to utilize her winning momentum
The 10 hold-up runners will create traffic problems in the home straight
Several runners including Bartolito and Good Onya Mate show fade tendencies

races.paceDynamic: Rising Sky will lead uncontested with On The Cards, Barretstown, and Rushford sitting close behind in the opening exchanges. This creates a moderate gallop with the large hold-up contingent (Captain Hanley, Storm Eric, Palazzo Persico, Star Mind, Harbanaker) tracking from midfield, setting up a traditional staying test where the pace will build gradually from halfway.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favors Stalkers
scenarios.trigger: If Rising Sky maintains a solid tempo throughout without letting the pace drop
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run but the pace proves testing enough for the hold-up horses to close strongly. Storm Eric and Star Mind benefit from the even gallop to produce their best finishing efforts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Rising Sky slows the tempo significantly in the middle stages creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with plenty left in the tank for a final furlong dash. Captain Hanley and Palazzo Persico capitalize on their proven finishing kicks when the race becomes tactical.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Control Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Rising Sky and the prominent group maintain control with no serious challenge from behind
scenarios.body: The early pace-setters never come back to the field on this stiff track. Rising Sky stays on strongly while On The Cards finds improvement at this longer trip to secure the places.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Explosive Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Rising Sky goes too slowly early allowing multiple horses to improve position turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where positioning proves crucial and the best finisher wins. Star Mind's higher rating tells in a blanket finish where class separates the field in the final 100 yards.

watchPoints.text: Rising Sky's early tempo setting - if he goes too fast early he'll compromise his own chances and set it up for closers
Rushford's position turning for home - his fading pattern means he needs to be very close at the two-furlong pole to be competitive
Storm Eric's progress from the back - his consistent placed efforts suggest he's due a win if getting the right pace setup
The gap between leaders and hold-up horses at halfway - too big a gap will make it impossible for the closers to get involved
Star Mind's position in the field - as the highest-rated runner his finishing position will indicate if the pace scenario suited
